purpose: Initial-state-only B2 encounter screening; inspected engineering pilot, no learned gate or extra force terms

protocol.forecast_inputs: One initial asteroid state, start epoch, horizon, fixed physics constants and daily planetary ephemerides; no future asteroid states or oracle labels
protocol.forecast_force_model: B2 solar two-body, solar-distance step guard only; no planetary force, GR, SB16, J2 or nominal NG
protocol.forecast_grid: Uniform cadence fixed by strategy and final horizon; never uses reference asteroid or known event refinement times
protocol.reference: Independent piecewise cubic-Hermite minima of the stored asteroid/planet snapshot, with union of their raw nodes and stored Apophis/Earth/Moon refinement; not exact continuous truth
protocol.alerts: A case/body is positive if its constrained-window minimum separation <= threshold; thresholds are exploratory and fixed before this run, not safety boundaries
protocol.metrics: Case/body TP/FN/FP/TN, misses, signed distance/time errors and total forecast-plus-screening runtime for each independently executed horizon
protocol.dependence: Nested horizons and repeated Apophis lead times are correlated; stress cases are reported separately and do not constitute independent encounters
protocol.timing: Three serial repeats, strategy order rotated; daily planetary ephemerides resident; force setup, propagation, planet interpolation and screening included; data loading and reference evaluation separate
protocol.next_stage: Use the measured screening limitations before selecting force models; additional small perturbations explicitly deferred
